hero.eyebrow: Online exams and question bank management
hero.title: From your question bank
hero.description: Testhub helps lecturers manage questions, build exams, run sessions and track results. Students take exams, practise and review published results in the same system.

bank.label: Organised by topic, chapter and cognitive level

results.label: Grading, regrading and printable exam reports

roles.title: The right tools for each user.
roles.description: Administrators, lecturers and students each have a workspace tailored to their responsibilities in the system.

lecturer.title: Lecturers
lecturer.description: Manage questions and documents, build exams, manage participants, monitor sessions and review results.

student.title: Students
student.description: Find exams, request to join, take exams or practise, and review published results.

admin.title: Administrators
admin.description: Manage users, exams and question banks, and view system-wide summary statistics.

mockup.disclaimer: Illustrative interface and sample data. Unusual events are reference signals, not automatic evidence of cheating.

features.title: A connected workflow for teaching, learning and assessment.
features.description: From preparing content to publishing results, the tools are connected in one workspace.

library.title: A structured question bank
library.description: Organise questions by topic, nested chapters and cognitive level. Support single-choice, multiple-answer and essay questions, with Word and Excel imports.

schedule.title: Exams and practice sessions
schedule.description: Set opening and closing times and exam duration. Select questions manually or configure distributions to build an exam from the question bank.

security.title: Live exam status monitoring
security.description: Track candidates taking an exam, submitting or losing connection, and view tab-switch and fullscreen-exit events. These are reference signals, not conclusions of cheating.

analytics.title: Exam results and reports
analytics.description: Automatically grade choice questions and review answers and results for each attempt. Lecturers can regrade, publish results and print summary or individual exam reports.

ai.title: AI-assisted questions from documents
ai.description: Upload a PDF or PowerPoint, build a topic × cognitive-level matrix and generate drafts with source citations. Lecturers edit, approve and select questions to save to the bank; drafts are not saved automatically.

documents.title: Learning document library
documents.description: Manage topic-based documents and versions, preview extracted content and search indexed documents. AI processing requires consent to send content to Google.

steps.title: From preparing an exam to reviewing results in four steps.
steps.description: Lecturers control content and exams; students participate using their own accounts.

create.title: Prepare questions and exams
create.description: Create or import questions, or review AI-assisted drafts. Select exam questions and configure the exam schedule.

invite.title: Manage participants
invite.description: Add students to an exam or approve their requests to join.

take.title: Take exams and monitor
take.description: Students take exams in the browser. Lecturers track connection status, progress and exam events.

report.title: Grade and publish results
report.description: Review results, regrade when needed and publish to students. Print a summary or individual exam report.

cta.title: One place for questions, exams and results.
cta.description: Log in to access your role-based workspace, or create an account if you are new to Testhub.

footer.description: Testhub brings together question banks, learning documents, AI-assisted question authoring and online exams for lecturers, students and administrators.
footer.roleNote: Available functions depend on your account role and permissions.
